an4.71:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya. Katamehi catuhi? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti bahussuto hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti. Catuhi
